issue.title: API server segfault when PYTHONASYNCIODEBUG=1
issue.body:
### Apache Airflow version

3.1.6

### If "Other Airflow 3 version" selected, which one?

_No response_

### What happened?

Same issue as in https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/53105

When the ENV var PYTHONASYNCIODEBUG=1 is set, api-server segfaults as soon as it gets it's first task to execute.

### What you think should happen instead?

_No response_

### How to reproduce

Using Airflow 3.1.6, python 3.13

DAG:

```
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.sdk import task


@task
def test():
    print("a")

with DAG(dag_id="test"):
    test()
```

pip freeze on api server container
